Alex: Where do we change the routing/ownership for the inference-high-latency alert? We keep getting pages to platform-oncall but it should go to infra first and retry to platform after 10m.

Jamie: You need two places: the alert metadata (so PD service tag is correct) and the PagerDuty escalation policy for the service. For our Prometheus alerts we set `pagerduty_service` in the alert annotations. Then PD handles the escalation timings.

Alex: Can you point me to the file or console?

Jamie: Dashboard link for context: https://console.redwood-inference.com/observability/dashboards/latency-inference. The alert lives in our alert repo: `infra/alerts/prometheus/alerts.yaml` — look for `inference_high_latency`. Example annotation change:

```
- alert: InferenceHighLatency
  expr: job:llm_inference_latency_seconds:95 > 1.2
  annotations:
    summary: "Inference latency > 1.2s (95th)"
    pagerduty_service: "infra-service"
    runbook: "https://docs.redwood-inference.com/runbooks/inference-latency"
```

Jamie: After you update the annotation, open a PR to the alerts repo; CI will validate. Then we change the PD escalation policy if needed via PagerDuty UI (or terraform in `infra/terraform/pagerduty/` if you prefer infra-as-code).

Sara: If we change the PD service to infra-service, does platform-oncall still get a fallback? We want platform to still be paged if infra doesn't ack for 10 minutes.

Jamie: Yes — set escalation policy to: 0m -> infra (page all), 10m -> platform (page), 20m -> engineering manager. If you're using terraform, update `pagerduty/escalations.tf` and run `terraform apply` (ask SRE for approval).

Evan: Do I need any perms to edit the alerts repo and PD config?

Jamie: For alerts repo: normal repo permissions (you can PR). For PD terraform, only SRE or oncall-admin can apply. If you can't apply, create the PR and tag `@sre` for apply.

Oncall Bot: note: current escalation for `inference-service` is infra->platform, but slack mapping for `#platform-oncall` is wired to the old service name. Consider updating Slack PD integration mapping at https://pagerduty.com/integrations/slack/configuration.

Alex: OK I'll open the PR for the annotation change now and add the suggested escalation steps in the description. Can someone from SRE review the terraform after? @Jamie @Evan

Jamie: Happy to review. If you paste the PR link here I can kick off the TF review. Also add a test alert (low severity) so we can verify slack routing without real pages. :thumbsup:

Evan: I'll coordinate the PD terraform apply once PR is merged and get approval from `@sre` and `@oncall-admins`.

Alex: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-alerts/pull/482 — changed annotation & added test alert.

Jamie: Looking... small nit: change label `team: inference` to `team: infra` for ownership. After that I'm good to approve.

Sara: Thanks — once this is live can we add a note in the runbook about who to page for degraded models? Saves time during late-night pages.

Jamie: Agreed — add runbook update in the same PR or a follow-up doc.

Alex: Will do. Thanks all.
